module: Displays an on-screen notification when the player changes vehicle or seat: vehicle name (brand, name, configuration), icon by type, occupied seat or spectator mode, and the number of selectable vehicles (current position). Clears the message when the player has no vehicle anymore or switches to walking mode (unicycle). Goes through guihooks.trigger('Message', ...) with the category "vehicleSwitch<player>". Global: freeroam_vehicleSwitchNotification.
notes: Icon: Trailer -> smallTrailer, Prop -> trafficCone, Truck -> boxTruck, Car -> car, other type -> beamNG; default car.

The vehicles counted as "selectable" exclude: unicycle, non-playerUsable, inactive, blacklisted (gameplay_walk.isVehicleBlacklisted) and the Types PropParked/PropTraffic. If the switch_next_vehicle/switch_previous_vehicle actions are blocked, the count is forced to 1 / index 0.
The message depends on presence.seatId (seat, via gameplay_seatOccupants.getSeats for the name) or on presence.permissionMode ('passenger' = spectator, otherwise full controls).

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Vehicle change hook: if the new vehicle does not exist or is the unicycle, clears this player's notification (clear=true).

onPlayerVehiclePresenceChanged.desc: Hook called when a player's presence in a vehicle/seat changes: displays the corresponding notification.
